AGENDA
  CITY COUNCIL MEETING
  JULY 21, 2020
UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, CITY COUNCIL MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE
PROVISIONS OF THE GOVERNOR'S EXECUTIVE ORDER N-25-20, WHICH ALLOWS MEETINGS TO BE
CLOSED TO THE PUBLIC AND VIDEOCONFERENCED. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING,
EITHER SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov OR DIAL INTO THE GOTOMEETING AT
(562) 247-8422, ACCESS CODE: 147-042-436 TO SPEAK ON AN ITEM OR UNDER ORAL
COMMUNICATIONS.  DETAILS  ARE  AVAILABLE  ON  THE  CITY'S  WEBPAGE  AT:
https://www.norwalk.org/city-hall/meeting-agendas-393, which is also where the meeting may be viewed.
  6:00 PM
  VIDEOCONFERENCE
  AND VIA VIDEOCONFERENCE

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember
  Public Comment: Comments may be made in person, submitted via email at: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, or through
  the video conference during the designated time on any item on the agenda or on any other matter within the jurisdiction
  subject to the rules of decorum described in Norwalk Municipal Code §2.08.020. The maximum time allowed is three
  minutes.

  Pursuant to provisions of the Brown Act, no action may be taken on a matter unless it is listed on the agenda, or unless
  certain emergency or special circumstances exist. The City Council may direct staff to investigate and/or schedule certain
  matters for consideration at a future City Council meeting.

  Please adhere to the following procedures when addressing the Council:

  • Comments should be limited to 3 minutes or less.
  • Comments should be directed to the City Council as a whole and not directed to individual Councilmembers.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk's Department, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.

  Note: Any writings and/or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it
  has been posted will also be made available for public inspection.

  Writings and/or documents are available for inspection in the City Clerk's Department, City Hall, 12700 Norwalk Boulevard
  during regular business hours, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday - Thursday and 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., every other Friday;
  telephone (562) 929-5720. You may also contact the City Clerk via e mail at recordsrequests@norwalkca.gov.

  STUDY SESSION MEETING
   5:00 P.M.

REGULAR MEETING
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  Jennifer Perez, Mayor
  Tony Ayala, Vice Mayor
  Rick Ramirez, Councilmember
  Margarita L. Rios, Councilmember
  Ana Valencia, Councilmember

  STUDY SESSION MEETING – 5:00 p.m.

CALL TO ORDER

CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor

CITY COUNCIL COMMENTS

  a.  Report of City Council Travel

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

CONSENT CALENDAR

Consent calendar items are considered routine matters which may be enacted by one motion and roll call vote.
Any item may be removed from the consent calendar and considered separately by City Council.

  1.  MEETING MINUTES – Staff recommends City Council approve the minutes of the meeting of July 7,
  2020. 825-04

  Minutes

  2.  PAYROLL – Staff recommends City Council approve the payroll for the period June 14, 2020 –
  June 27, 2020, in the total amount of $835,223.30. 630

  Report

  3.  COMMERCIAL DEMANDS – Staff recommends City Council approve the warrant register period July
  1, 2020 - July 14, 2020, in the total amount of $1,667,127.12. 640

  Report

  4.  CLAIMS AGAINST THE CITY – Staff recommends City Council deny the claim filed by Christine Bernal
  Hernandez. 830-08

  Report

  5.  PLANNING COMMISSION SYNOPSIS – JULY 8, 2020 - No action is required unless the City Council
  elects to review the decision of the Planning Commission on those items where the Commission’s
  action was final. 320

  Synopsis

  6.  RESOLUTION NO. 20-53 – FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT AND
  STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE FUND – Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-53, A
  RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORWALK ADOPTING THE
  TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT AND STATE TRANSIT ASSISTANCE FUNDS FOR
  FISCAL YEAR 2020/21. 1105-02

  Report

  7.  PROJECT NO. 3302-2021 - AWARD OF CONTRACT FOR ANNUAL CITYWIDE SIDEWALK
  CONCRETE REPAIR AND REPLACEMENT, ENGINEER’S REPORT NO. 20-12 – Staff recommends
  City Council award a contract to CJ Concrete Construction, Inc. of Santa Fe Springs in the amount of
  $222,600 for Project No. 3302-2021, citywide sidewalk concrete repair and replacement; and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement and any extension/amendments including potential change
  orders, provided there is funding in the budget, on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City
  Attorney.1005-04-3302-2021

  Report
 8.  CONFIRM EMERGENCY WORK – REPAIR OF SEWER LATERAL AT ROSECRANS AVENUE AND
  GREENSTONE AVENUE - Staff recommends City Council confirm the emergency repair work at
  Rosecrans Avenue and Greenstone Avenue completed by Steven Doreck Equipment Rentals, Inc., in
  the amount of $11,506.70. 955

  Report

9.  PROJECT NO. 7923 - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT
  FUNDED LOCAL STREET REHABILITATION – ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 20-10 - Staff recommends
  City Council accept the work of R. J. Noble Company of Orange for $547,445.34 for Project No. 7923 -
  Local Street Rehabilitation. 1005-04-7923

  Report

10. PROJECT NO. 7786.1 - ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - PHASE II CONSTRUCTION OF THE
  TRANSPORTATION/PUBLIC SERVICES MUNICIPAL AUXILIARY LOT AT 12824 IMPERIAL
  HIGHWAY – ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 20-13 - Staff recommends City Council accept the work of
  Parsam Construction, Inc. of Glendale in the amount of $1,529,324.45 for the Phase II construction of
  Project No. 7786.1 - Transportation/Public Services Municipal Auxiliary Lot. 1005-04-7786

  Report

11. RESOLUTION NO. 20-54 – AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED BUDGET AND
  ACCEPTANCE OF WORK - CITYWIDE ANNUAL SIDEWALK/CONCRETE REPAIR AND
  REPLACEMENT PROJECT NO. 3302-1920 – ENGINEERS REPORT NO. 20-14 - Staff recommends
  City Council:

  a.  adopt Resolution No. 20-54, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  NORWALK AUTHORIZING AN AMENDMENT TO THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 ADOPTED
  BUDGET TO APPROPRIATE TRANSPORTATION DEVELOPMENT ACT ARTICLE 3 FUNDS
  FOR AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES CURB RAMP INSTALLATIONS, in the amount of
  $61,390; and

  b.  accept the work of CT&T Concrete Paving, Inc. in the amount of $309,238 for citywide annual
  sidewalk/concrete repair and replacement and Americans with Disabilities curb ramp installations.
  1005-04-3302-1920

  Report

12. AGREEMENT AMENDMENT NO. 5 – GRANT RESEARCH AND WRITING SERVICES – Staff
  recommends City Council approve Amendment No. 5 with Blais and Associates, Inc., in an amount not
  to exceed $50,000 for grant research and writing services from July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2021;
  and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on behalf of the City, in a form approved by
  the City Attorney. 623

  Report

13. AMENDMENT NO. 7 TO AGREEMENT WITH KJ SERVICES ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTING
  SERVICES FOR OIL PAYMENT AND BEVERAGE CONTAINER PROGRAM COMMUNITY
  OUTREACH AND PUBLIC EDUCATION SERVICES - Staff recommends City Council approve
  Amendment No. 7 with KJ Services Environmental Consulting in the amount of $22,000 annually from
  July 1, 2020 through June 30, 2022 for consultant services associated with the Oil Payment and
  Beverage Container Grant Program; and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment on
  behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1065-04-01

  Report

14. AMENDMENT NO. 5 - WASTE MANAGEMENT (WM) CURBSIDE, LLC AGREEMENT FOR
  RESIDENTIAL USED MOTOR OIL COLLECTION PROGRAM - Staff recommends City Council
  approve Amendment No. 5 with WM Curbside, LLC for Used Oil Collection Program services, in an
  amount not to exceed $10,000 per year through June 30, 2021; and authorize the City Manager to
  execute the amendment on behalf of the City, in a form approved by the City Attorney. 1065-04-01

  Report
   15. PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION APPROVAL OF BLUE CURB AT 14829 NORWALK BOULEVARD -
  No action is required unless the City Council elects to review the decision of the Public Safety
  Commission regarding approval of the blue curb. 265-05

  Report

  16. ORDINANCE NOS. 20-1717 – ADOPTING ZONE CHANGE NO. 361; 20-1718 – ADOPTING A
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT – FIRESTONE BOULEVARD CUL-DE-SAC SOUTH OF
  ROSECRANS AVENUE – Staff recommends City Council accept for second reading and adopt:

  a.  Ordinance No. 20-1717, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK SETTING FORTH ITS
  FINDINGS OF FACT AND DECISION APPROVING ZONE CHANGE NO. 361; and

  b.  Ordinance No. 20-1718, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING A
  DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF NORWALK AND EVERGREEN MEDIA
  LLC APPROVING A NEW DIGITAL BILLBOARD SIGN ON FIRESTONE BOULEVARD SOUTH
  OF ROSECRANS AVENUE ADJACENT TO THE I-5 FREEWAY. 320-09-361/925-13

  Report

  17. DELINQUENT WEED AND LITTER COLLECTION FEES – Staff recommends City Council:

  a.  confirm the attached report of the Property Maintenance and Building Rehabilitation Appeals
  Board adjusted to reflect the current outstanding balance; and

  b.  authorize the Finance Director to file a copy of this report with the County Auditor on or before
  August 10, 2020 in order to place a lien on the property. 626-01

  Report

  18. RESOLUTION NO. 20-55 – MODIFICATION TO THE CITY’S COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK
  GRANT ECONOMIC RECOVERY STIMULUS PROGRAM (SMALL BUSINESS LOAN PROGRAM) –
  Staff recommends City Council adopt Resolution No. 20-55, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL
  OF THE CITY OF NORWALK APPROVING MODIFICATION OF THE CITY’S COMMUNITY
  DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT ECONOMIC RECOVERY STIMULUS PROGRAM (SMALL
  BUSINESS LOAN PROGRAM). 315-01

  Report

APPOINTMENTS

  19. ADVISORY BODIES – Staff recommends City Council make appointments to fill the vacancies on the
  various City advisory bodies. 200

  Report

PUBLIC HEARING

  20. DELINQUENT REFUSE COLLECTION ACCOUNTS - Staff recommends City Council approve the lien
  lists for the delinquent accounts that are not paid by July 31, 2020, and authorize staff to forward a final
  list to the Los Angeles County Tax Assessor. 626-02

  Report

REPORT

  21. STATE HOUSING LEGISLATIVE UPDATE - Provided for City Council information. 850-03

  Report

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS

ADJOURNMENT
 I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted
on the City Hall bulletin board not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. Dated July 17, 2020.

Theresa Devoy, CMC
City Clerk
